newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thirty four Thai workers injured in plant collapse.
newsitem.headline: Thirty four Thai workers injured in plant collapse.

text.p: A candle factory on the outskirts of Bangkok collapsed on Wednesday, injuring 34 Thai workers, most of them women, police said.
The iron building in Nonthaburi province just north of the capital belonged to Siam Quality Industry company. It collapsed late in the morning, police said.
About 130 people were working inside at the time, and three of them suffered critical injuries, the public health ministry said.
The owner of the factory was arrested on charges of negligence causing injury and for violating building codes.
